name: meta-webhook-inbound

description.en: A real WhatsApp/Instagram message from a customer arrives through Meta's signed webhook into the venue's inbox.
description.uk: Справжнє вхідне повідомлення WhatsApp/Instagram через підписаний вебхук Meta потрапляє у вхідні закладу.

external.api_version: Graph v21.0; x-hub-signature-256 = sha256 HMAC of the body with the app secret

auth.where: MISSING: as row 7 plus a second WhatsApp number A that messages B

schema_status: draft: tighten from the first live answer
probe: Number A sends to number B whose webhook is qa-durres; GET /api/owner/inbox shows the text. A self-signed POST is not counted.
